Hi Jonas,

Quick context — CloudBridge (our SI) is running a week-long POC with our internal analytics team against the Redwood hosted API. Usage has spiked and we’re close to exhausting the trial credits the SI received. The POC is on track (proof points attached) and CloudBridge has asked if Redwood can top up an additional $10k in partner-sourced credits so we can finish end-to-end validation next week.

Would you be able to approve a partner promo credit for this POC or advise the right person? We can share a short mutual action plan and milestone checks if that helps.

Thanks,

Senior Product Manager — Data Platform
ZephyrHealth

Hi Amit — thanks for the note and the usage report. Great to hear the POC is producing signal.

Sofia / Mina — looping you in to see if we can authorize a short-term partner credit top-up (targeting $10k) for Zephyr/CloudBridge to complete the validation. If we approve, I recommend:
- Credit duration: 2 weeks from activation
- Milestones: completion of core ingestion tests + perf/latency review (CloudBridge to confirm)
- Usage guardrail: cap at $10k + auto-disable if usage exceeds threshold without a signed MAP

If this looks good I can trigger the partner-credit flow and attach the partner-credit-form for signatures. Amit — can you confirm the milestone checklist and point of contact at CloudBridge for acceptance?

Best,

Thanks for the thread. Jonas — I approve a one-time $10k partner-topup to finish this POC with these conditions:
1) MAP or short SOW signed by Zephyr + CloudBridge within 7 days of activation.
2) We set a hard spend limit and daily alerts to the partnerships ops inbox.
3) If the POC converts to paid within 30 days, we’ll apply up to 25% of the credit toward first-month committed capacity (standard uplift clause).

Mina — please set up the credit in the partner portal and route the partner-credit-form to Zephyr and CloudBridge. Use DEAL-2026-1792 on all paperwork and add the HubSpot link to the record.

Amit/Elena — please confirm who will sign the MAP and the BI contact at CloudBridge so Mina can finalize.

Sofia Ivanova
Head of Partnerships Operations
Redwood Inference
